Indian Universities Recognized in Global Higher Education Rankings

Several Indian universities have been recognized in recent global higher education rankings. MAHE achieved a top global position for Sustainable Development Goal 5 in the Times Higher Education Impact Rankings 2026. Manipal University Jaipur also secured a place in the 201-300 band in the same rankings. Separately, other universities were noted in engineering and technology rankings.
